categories.description: Fully managed, vendor-hosted LLMs exposed as simple APIs. You send prompts; the provider handles hosting, scaling, safety features, and updates.
Hyperscaler and data-cloud platforms that host foundation models with governance, tuning, evals, monitoring, RAG, and cloud integrations.
Specialized providers focused on high-performance model serving, fine-tuning, batch jobs, and dedicated or serverless endpoints.
Abstraction layers for routing, fallback, caching, observability, cost controls, guardrails, and policy across many model providers.
Raw GPU compute, GPU clusters, or serverless GPU pods you control to run your own inference stack.
Turnkey software/hardware stacks to run LLMs in private data centers, including regulated and air-gapped environments.
Self-hostable runtimes/servers for deploying LLMs anywhere, including cloud, on-prem, and private clusters.
Desktop apps/CLIs that download and run models on a laptop, workstation, or local server.
SDKs/runtimes to run compact or optimized models directly on phones, PCs with NPUs, or embedded/edge devices.

options.name: OpenAI API
options.notes: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna with 1.05M-token context, plus image, audio, GPT Transcribe, realtime, embeddings, computer use, built-in tools, multi-agent orchestration, and programmatic tool calling through the Responses API, Daybreak Blue/Red security tiers, and a limited-preview Ultrafast tier for GPT-5.6 Sol.

options.name: Claude API
options.notes: Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 4.8, and earlier Claude 4.x models with 1M-token context, adjustable effort levels, fast mode, tool use, computer use, and limited Mythos 5 access for defensive cybersecurity.

options.name: Gemini API
options.notes: Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Gemini Live, Omni Flash video generation/editing, image generation, Gemini Robotics-ER 2 preview, long context, computer use, and Google AI Studio access.

options.name: Azure OpenAI Service
options.notes: OpenAI models on Azure with enterprise controls.

options.name: Cohere API
options.notes: Command A+, Command A family, North Mini Code, embeddings, and rerank APIs, with Model Vault deployment options for enterprise workloads.

options.name: Mistral La Plateforme (API)
options.notes: Mistral Medium 3.5, Mistral Small 4, Leanstral 1.5, OCR 4.1, Devstral, Voxtral, Shieldstral moderation, function calling, agents, and streaming.

options.name: AI21 Studio / AI21 API
options.notes: Jamba/J2 models, text & embeddings.

options.name: Aleph Alpha API
options.notes: Luminous/Alpha family with multimodal & explainability.

options.name: Grok API
options.notes: Grok 4.6 with a 500K-token context and configurable reasoning effort, Grok 4.5, Grok 4.3, voice, image, tool use, and an OpenAI-compatible API.

options.name: DeepSeek API
options.notes: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813 update with stronger agent capabilities and native Responses API support) and V4 Flash through an OpenAI-compatible API; peak/off-peak pricing with higher rates takes effect August 16, 2026.

options.name: Meta Model API
options.notes: Public-preview API for Meta's Muse models, starting with the multimodal, agent-oriented Muse Spark 1.1.

options.name: QwenCloud
options.notes: Generally available Qwen API platform with Qwen 3.8 Max, Qwen 3.7, Audio 3.0 realtime/TTS/ASR, Wan 3.0, Qwen Image 3.0, and partner models such as GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek V4 through OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

options.name: Amazon Bedrock
options.notes: Multi-provider model hub with Amazon Nova 2, Claude 5 (including Opus 5), OpenAI GPT-5.6 and Daybreak, Grok, open-weight, embedding, image, and speech models, plus a built-in Web Search tool; availability varies by region.

options.name: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
options.notes: Deploy 400+ open-weights FMs incl. DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral.

options.name: Vertex AI (Generative AI)
options.notes: Managed Gemini 3.7/3.6/3.5 and partner models, including Claude Opus 5, with versioned endpoints, tuning, grounding, evaluation, and model lifecycle controls.

options.name: Microsoft Foundry - Model Catalog
options.notes: Current Microsoft Foundry catalog for Microsoft MAI, OpenAI, Anthropic (including Claude Opus 5), DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cohere, Meta, and Fireworks-served open-weight partner models.

options.name: IBM watsonx.ai
options.notes: Granite + third-party/open models; Model Gateway.

options.name: Snowflake Cortex
options.notes: Built-in LLM functions and model access inside Snowflake.

options.name: Databricks Mosaic AI Model Serving
options.notes: Serve open-weight, custom, and hosted partner models, including current Claude and Grok releases, with serverless endpoints and tools for RAG and agents.

options.name: Oracle OCI Generative AI
options.notes: Managed generative AI (models & tuning).

options.name: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
options.notes: Hosted endpoints with autoscaling & TGI/vLLM engines.

options.name: Together AI
options.notes: High-throughput OSS model inference & fine-tuning; building a dedicated NVIDIA HGX B300 inference cluster on IBM Cloud under a $240M multi-year deal (available Q1 2027).

options.name: Fireworks AI
options.notes: Fast inference for OSS models, tool use, agents; also sold as Fireworks-served open models inside the Microsoft Foundry catalog.

options.name: Replicate
options.notes: Run models as APIs; deploy your own containers.

options.name: Baseten
options.notes: Production LLM inference; dedicated deployments.

options.name: Modal
options.notes: Bring-your-code serverless GPU compute for inference.

options.name: GroqCloud
options.notes: Ultra-low-latency inference for supported open models on Groq LPUs; joined the NVIDIA Cloud Partner program to add NVIDIA accelerated capacity alongside LPUs.

options.name: Cerebras Inference
options.notes: High-throughput LLM inference on Cerebras wafer-scale hardware with OpenAI-compatible chat completions and dedicated endpoints; also powers OpenAI's Ultrafast tier for GPT-5.6 Sol (up to 750 tokens/s).

options.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
options.notes: Serverless GPU inference on Cloudflare's global network with 50+ open-source models, now unified with AI Gateway so the same AI binding, billing, and observability cover Workers AI and third-party provider models, plus Vectorize and agent-building primitives.

options.name: Nebius AI Studio
options.notes: Managed open-source model inference for text, embeddings, image, guardrails, and vision workloads with configurable GPU-backed endpoint flavors.

options.name: OpenRouter
options.notes: Meta-API routing across 100s of models/providers, with Ori Eval model evaluation, generation tagging, team spend controls, and live web-search benchmarks.

options.name: Portkey
options.notes: Model catalog, routing, guardrails, observability.

options.name: Helicone Gateway
options.notes: Routing, caching, telemetry for LLM APIs.

options.name: CoreWeave
options.notes: GPU VMs & inference stacks for self-hosting.

options.name: Lambda Cloud
options.notes: On-demand GPUs & clusters for training/inference.

options.name: Crusoe Cloud
options.notes: Sustainable GPU cloud for AI workloads.

options.name: RunPod
options.notes: Pods & serverless GPUs; templates for TGI/vLLM/SGLang.

options.name: Vast.ai
options.notes: Spot rental GPUs; TGI serverless templates.

options.name: VMware Private AI Foundation with NVIDIA
options.notes: NVIDIA NIM microservices, Model Store, secure on-prem AI.

options.name: Red Hat OpenShift AI
options.notes: Lifecycle mgmt & serving for predictive/gen-AI at scale.

options.name: HPE Private Cloud AI
options.notes: Turnkey AI factory systems with NVIDIA GPUs.

options.name: Dell AI Factory / Platforms
options.notes: Validated designs & turnkey ‘AI factory’ systems.

options.name: NVIDIA NIM
options.notes: Inference microservices for LLMs (NGC, Triton, TensorRT-LLM).

options.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
options.notes: Multi-framework inference server; LLM backends incl. TensorRT-LLM.

options.name: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM
options.notes: High-performance LLM runtime & kernels; Triton backend.

options.name: KServe
options.notes: CRDs for serving predictive & generative models; LLM features.

options.name: Seldon Core
options.notes: K8s-native model serving & monitoring.

options.name: Ray Serve (LLM APIs)
options.notes: Distributed LLM serving with OpenAI-compatible APIs.

options.name: BentoML (LLM serving)
options.notes: Packaging & scaling LLM services; speculative decoding optimizations.

options.name: vLLM
options.notes: High-throughput LLM server with paged KV cache; v0.27 adds a Rust frontend with gRPC control plane, FlashAttention 4 on Blackwell, and Kimi K3 support.

options.name: Text Generation Inference (TGI)
options.notes: Hugging Face inference server in maintenance mode since December 2025. Existing deployments remain supported, but Hugging Face recommends vLLM or SGLang for new production workloads.

options.name: SGLang
options.notes: Fast serving engine for LLM/VLM with EP & KV-reuse features; v0.5.17 adds Kimi K3 day-0 support, a Rust server frontend, and DSpark speculative decoding.

options.name: LMDeploy (TurboMind/PyTorch engines)
options.notes: Inference/serving toolkit; supports popular OSS models.

options.name: llama.cpp
options.notes: CPU/GPU-portable LLM inference in C/C++; quantization support.

options.name: Ollama
options.notes: One-line local model runner & registry with OpenAI-compatible chat and Responses APIs (including web search), an MLX engine on Apple Silicon, and day-0 support for Muse Glimmer, Qwen 3.8, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning.

options.name: LM Studio
options.notes: GUI to run/chat with local models plus LM Studio Bionic hybrid local/US-hosted access to models such as Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Muse Glimmer.

options.name: GPT4All (Desktop)
options.notes: Fully local chatbot app; optional local API server.

options.name: Koboldcpp
options.notes: Lightweight UI/server for local LLMs; roleplay/story use cases.

options.name: MLC LLM
options.notes: WebGPU & native runtimes for local OSS models.

options.name: Apple MLX / mlx-lm
options.notes: Apple-optimized local LLM library on MLX.

options.name: Intel OpenVINO GenAI
options.notes: Optimized CPU/iGPU inference for LLMs with quantization.

options.name: ONNX Runtime GenAI
options.notes: Run SLMs/LLMs on CPU/GPU/NPU; Windows ML & DirectML support.

options.name: NVIDIA Jetson (Generative AI/NIM on Jetson)
options.notes: Embedded LLM/VLM deployment on Jetson platforms.

options.name: Qualcomm AI Hub (on-device)
options.notes: On-device LLM workflows for Snapdragon platforms.

options.name: Argonne ALCF Inference Endpoints
options.notes: API access to OSS models on HPC hardware.
